caption: The drawing features two distinct objects set against a blank, light-colored background. On the left side, there is an object resembling a long-handled tool with a heart-shaped end and two elongated rods or handles joining at the heart shape, rendered in dark gray pencil or charcoal strokes, with shading indicating dimensionality. The heart-shaped portion is solid and appears to have layered sections, shown with parallel lines, and casts a shadow beneath it. To the right of this object, there is a separate heart-shaped item, also shaded in gray. This object has two circular patterns at the rounded upper sections of the heart and a grid-like pattern filling the lower part within its outline, suggesting embossed or raised detailing. Both objects are drawn with emphasis on outline and shading for depth, utilizing a monochromatic palette of grays and blacks on a plain, unshaded background.
title: Pa. German Waffle Iron
